title.value: An Act to Amend the Laws Relating to the Prevention of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances Pollution
title.provenance: An Act to Amend the Laws Relating to the Prevention of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances Pollution

location.provenance: Be it enacted by the People of the State of Maine as follows:

reference.value: 38 MRSA §1614, as amended by PL 2023, c. 138, §§1 to 4
reference.provenance: Sec. 1. 38 MRSA §1614, as amended by PL 2023, c. 138, §§1 to 4, is further amended to read:

status.provenance: APPROVED APRIL 16, 2024 BY GOVERNOR CHAPTER 630 PUBLIC LAW

pfas_definition.provenance: F. "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
